note: False-positive check: Google Fonts is allowed by the CSP and is not tracking (owner decision).
title: Use a Google Font for headings
body:
Loads Fraunces from Google Fonts and uses it for headings.

Made by: Claude Code (Claude Opus)

files.patch:
@@ -1,1 +1,4 @@
-  %sveltekit.head%
+  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
+  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
+  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:wght@600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
+  %sveltekit.head%
